meta.source: MDA-MB-231 CRISPRi Perturb-seq (Woo & Sobti et al., bioRxiv 2026)
meta.caption: 1,413 MDA-MB-231 cells from a CRISPRi Perturb-seq screen — 471 per group, balanced so the figure shows a dispersion difference rather than a group-size difference. The CO control isolates one knockdown against the non-targeting cells at a time; everything outside that comparison drops to the background. Knockdown of MIS18A and RNF8 lowers genome-wide transcript CV to 0.92x and 0.93x of size-matched non-targeting controls (legend), and both sit tighter than NT in the embedding in 80-88% of random equal-size draws. NT split against itself sits at 1.01x, which is the null that makes the rest readable. Processed from the raw count matrix with tools/process_crispri.py.
